description: This file implements a React component named LinkPreview that fetches and displays a preview of a URL, including image, title, description, and domain. It handles caching of fetch responses, suspense for lazy loading, and rendering logic for UI components.

methods.name: useSuspenseRequest
methods.description: Fetches a link preview asynchronously with caching, throwing a Promise for React suspense if not yet loaded.

methods.name: LinkPreviewContent
methods.description: Renders the link preview content including image, domain, title, and description based on fetched preview data.

methods.name: Glimmer
methods.description: A placeholder component with animated style used during loading state.
